steps.caption: Step 1: Initialize IOT_EMB_CR1 with EN bit asserted (0x80) [D33P1].
Step 2: Peripheral asserts RDY & IRQ flags (0xE0) on IOT_EMB_CR1.
Step 3: Enable DMA burst & CRC verification bits (0xF8).
